name: Italian Bistro Kitchen
svgFragment:
<g id="BG-BISTRO">
  <!-- Background Wall -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="540" fill="#92400e" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <!-- Brick Details -->
  <rect x="100" y="80" width="120" height="50" rx="4" fill="#b45309" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="240" y="150" width="120" height="50" rx="4" fill="#b45309" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="50" y="300" width="120" height="50" rx="4" fill="#b45309" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="1100" y="400" width="120" height="50" rx="4" fill="#b45309" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <!-- Floor -->
  <rect x="0" y="540" width="1280" height="180" fill="#451a03" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <!-- Distant Tables with Checkered Cloths -->
  <g id="distant-tables" transform="translate(100, 480)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="150" height="60" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="60" y="0" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="120" y="0" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="30" y="30" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="90" y="30" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
  </g>
  <g id="distant-tables-2" transform="translate(400, 480)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="150" height="60" fill="#ef4444" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
    <rect x="30" y="0" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="90" y="0" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="60" y="30" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
    <rect x="120" y="30" width="30" height="30" fill="#ffffff" />
  </g>

  <!-- Chalkboard Menu -->
  <rect x="850" y="60" width="340" height="300" fill="#1e293b" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="12" />
  <text x="880" y="120" fill="#f8fafc" font-family="'Courier New', Courier, monospace" font-size="32" font-weight="bold">MENU DU JOUR</text>
  <text x="880" y="180" fill="#fde68a" font-family="'Comic Sans MS', cursive" font-size="28">- Pasta Chaos</text>
  <text x="880" y="230" fill="#fde68a" font-family="'Comic Sans MS', cursive" font-size="28">- Espresso of</text>
  <text x="920" y="270" fill="#ef4444" font-family="'Comic Sans MS', cursive" font-size="36" font-weight="bold">DEATH</text>
  <path d="M 1100 280 Q 1130 320 1160 280" fill="none" stroke="#f8fafc" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Hanging Garlic and Sausages -->
  <line x1="200" y1="0" x2="200" y2="150" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="160" r="18" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="190" r="18" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="220" r="18" fill="#f1f5f9" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />

  <line x1="350" y1="0" x2="350" y2="100" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="335" y="100" width="30" height="60" rx="15" fill="#991b1b" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="335" y="165" width="30" height="60" rx="15" fill="#991b1b" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />
  <rect x="335" y="230" width="30" height="60" rx="15" fill="#991b1b" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Mood Lighting / Ambient Glow -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#warmGlow)" style="mix-blend-mode: overlay; pointer-events: none;" />
  
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="warmGlow" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fbbf24" stop-opacity="0.2" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.4" />
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="shadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="10" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.5" />
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Floor Shadow for Characters -->
  <ellipse cx="640" cy="680" rx="400" ry="30" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.2" />
</g>
